Subject: Redwood MSA - publicity/confidentiality redline notes

Team / Priya,

I reviewed the attached MSA and the Communications Checklist. Below are recommended edits and process notes for the publicity & confidentiality sections. Im attaching a redlined MSA for your review.

Key proposed contract language (high-level):
- Publicity: "Each party may identify the other as a customer or vendor in press releases and marketing materials with prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld. Customer shall have thirty (30) calendar days to review and approve any proposed customer quote or case study excerpt. Redwood may use the Customers name and logo to describe the relationship in sales collateral, subject to Customers prior approval of specific logo assets and usage guidelines."

- Confidentiality carveouts: Add a narrow carveout allowing non-confidential factual descriptions of the engagement for sales/marketing purposes but preserve anonymity if requested (e.g., "strategic cloud partner").

Operational asks:
- Formal approval flow: customer sends final quote and mockup -> Redwood product/marketing will review in 3 business days -> Legal will provide redline approval within 5 business days.
- Logo escrow: we provide a controlled logo pack and request that the customer uses only the approved assets; we add a rider referencing a shared Drive link and a usage checklist.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redline_20260203.docx (redline with tracked changes), Redwood_logo_pack_v2.zip (logo assets).

Open items for Priya:
- Please confirm whether Novasol needs the quote to be anonymized or if the company name can appear publicly.
- If you want a longer embargo window (e.g., 45 days), state that and well negotiate.

Ill finalize the tracked redlines and can prepare a 1-page mutual action plan for approvals once we agree on embargo/quote anonymization.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
